design_context: Defined after viewing development-tvae-exact-v1 diagnostics. Its application to that artifact is exploratory, not prospective validation.

privacy_screen.rationale: Require no exact fit-feature copies and a synthetic lower-tail distance at least as large as the held-out real lower-tail distance to the same fit reference. This is a conservative exploratory screening choice, not a calibrated privacy guarantee or a published acceptance threshold.

remaining_requirements: Review this exploratory screening definition before freezing a prospective benchmark protocol.
Assess sensitivity and uncertainty of distances with only 215 diagnosed internal-validation records.
Resolve simulated prescription confidence and C3 timestamp/signed utility alignment.
Freeze the complete benchmark and upstream evidence generation procedures.
